annotations.title: Hold a time and email the client to confirm

description: Use this when the person has picked a time from check_availability and said yes to its price and the cancellation policy. Holds that time for up to 15 minutes and emails the person, who confirms it with the link in the email or by reading you the 6-digit code from it. Nothing is booked until they confirm. Pass the person's own name and email address, their time zone and an idempotencyKey: a retry with the same key and details returns the same hold. To change a time you already held, release the earlier hold with release_hold first. Do not use for holding a time for someone who has not given you their own email address, or for taking a payment.

email.description: The person's own email address. They confirm the time from it.

clientTimeZone.description: The client's IANA time zone, such as America/Toronto. Ask for their city when unsure.

idempotencyKey.description: The same key and the same details for a retry of one hold; a new key for anything else.

slotId.description: A slotId from check_availability, used within 30 minutes.
